name: devrecap
description: Local-first, evidence-based developer activity intelligence: turns AI coding sessions + Git into presentation-ready work recaps.

comments.runtime: Runs on Node.js built-ins only (node:sqlite, node:http, node:test, node:zlib, fetch) with zero third-party installs. Node 24 LTS is the recommended runtime: it runs the project's .ts files directly via native type stripping WITHOUT extra flags, and ships node:sqlite. Node 24 is therefore the minimum supported version (see engines.node).
comments.stack: This project targets React + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Prisma + Zod as its canonical stack. The canonical dependencies below document the intended stack and are installed when running in an environment with npm access; the code is structured so migration is incremental. See .kiro/specs/devrecap/design.md section 2.
